title: Markdown FILE report renders full audit detail; terminal stays brief
rationale: trellis-89d6: src/report/markdown.ts now renders everything the audit graded (every criterion grouped by category with failing-first ordering, verdict/score/rationale, failing gate callout, canonical drift, changes-since-last-run), via a new projectCriteria() helper in rollup.ts that reuses criterionStatus/gateFails. Terminal renderer intentionally unchanged (brief banner + per-category table). JSON was already complete (JSON.stringify). Renderers stay pure projections; numbers come from rollup helpers so views never disagree.

title: Default audit report file anchors to the audited repo, not process.cwd()
rationale: trellis-c2af: planReportTarget anchored the default .trellis/ report dir to process.cwd(), so CLI/SDK tests spawning 'trellis audit <tempdir>' (no cwd, no --no-output) wrote timestamped audit-*.md into the REAL repo's gitignored .trellis/ (invisible pollution, N runs = N files since the filename is per-second). Fix: anchor the default dir to repoPath (a report about repo X belongs with repo X), and pass --no-output in tests that assert exit codes/output rather than artifacts. Test fixtures already rmSync their temp dir, so anchoring also self-cleans test reports.

title: A 1.0.0↔1.1.0 report pair compares its scored basis with a schema-span caveat instead of failing wholesale
rationale: trellis-bd0c (SPEC §16.6): schema 1.1.0 only adds the evidence area, so the scored measurement body is unchanged across the pair. compareReports emits a schema-span caveat, compares the scored basis (analyzer/scoring versions, scored catalogs — pre-provider 1.0.0 reports read with every metric as a score input), and reads the pre-provider side's provider evidence as unrequested (not-carried reason naming the predating schema), never as a regression. Only an unreadable schema version (unreachable through loadReportArtifact) keeps the defensive hard schema-version refusal.

title: Dashboard series anchor on decoded provenance; baseline walk-back (trellis-ab01)
rationale: src/history/dashboard.ts decodes the latest row via decodedStoredReport as the series anchor: an undecodable (foreign) latest row headlines the snapshot from its columns but yields no series and a null index delta — unknown provenance never implies compatibility. src/audit/run.ts recordRun resolves the baseline by latestCompatibleRun(identity, newReport), which walks back from the newest row to the latest scored-basis-compatible one instead of accepting the latest row blindly (read before insert, as before).

name: shared provider-evidence renderer vocabulary
description: How the three report renderers stay in agreement over provider evidence, plus a jscpd exact-mode grouping gotcha for tests.

title: Independent hotspot category and source-set bounds
rationale: A global first-ten list hides duplication/cycles and lets tests crowd out production. Cycle classification must use all SCC members, not a representative path.
